name: xiaoshi-robot (MuJoCo simulation, live.py in the browser)
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libegl1 libgl1 libglu1-mesa libosmesa6 espeak-ng && pip install mujoco numpy scipy imageio imageio-ffmpeg pillow pypinyin cmudict
postStartCommand: echo 'cd sim && python live.py --host 0.0.0.0   (then open the forwarded port 8000)'
